questions.q: How is the $9,200.00 bank variance's root cause ultimately confirmed?
options: By reversing the payment inside Oracle Fusion
By calling Regions Bank's commercial services desk, which confirms a network timeout caused a duplicate transmission
By asking Meridian Bearing Supply Co. to refund the extra amount
By assuming it was a data entry error and correcting the GL
questions.explain: The bank confirms the duplicate debit was caused by a network timeout retry on its own processor, not an error on LTV's side.

questions.q: What does the Subledger Accounting accounting events report reveal about the 14 Incomplete transactions?
options: They are all duplicate transactions that should be deleted
They are all 'Freight Charge' type transactions crediting account 7850, with no applicable Account Rule found
They all belong to the Canadian legal entity
They are all AP transactions, not Receivables
questions.explain: All 14 transactions share the same transaction type (Freight Charge), the same account (7850), and the same error (no applicable Account Rule).

questions.q: What does the journal batch status report reveal about INTERCO-JAN-0131?
options: It posted successfully but to the wrong period
It is sitting in Draft status, never submitted for approval or posting
It was rejected due to a currency mismatch
It was duplicated, creating two journals for the same amount
questions.explain: The journal batch status report shows INTERCO-JAN-0131 still in Draft status — complete and balanced, but never submitted.

questions.q: What three fundamentally different kinds of root cause does this lesson highlight across its three investigations?
options: Three variations of the same data entry mistake
A bank-side processing error, a Subledger Accounting configuration gap, and a missed manual submission step
Three separate currency conversion errors
Three unrelated supplier disputes
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly contrasts a bank error (outside Oracle Fusion), a configuration gap (inside SLA), and a simple missed step (submitting a journal) as different kinds of problems.

questions.q: By the end of lesson 20, how many of Elena Marsh's six symptoms have confirmed root causes?
options: Three
Four
Five
All six
questions.explain: Combined with lesson 19's three confirmed causes (AP, AR, Assets), lesson 20 confirms the remaining three (Cash Management, SLA, GL), completing all six.
